name: Upstash Search Free
free_limit: One ongoing Upstash Search Free database: 20,000 search queries/month and up to 200,000 records
watch_out: Free is a distinct capped database tier. Adding a credit card upgrades the database to pay-as-you-go ($0.05 per 1,000 billed search/upsert requests), where the Free query cap no longer applies; no automatic unlimited free usage. Pro/Enterprise trials offered on request are separate from this ongoing Free plan.
